title: Weekly Active Minutes vs Recommendation
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fitbit:activity
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(active_minutes) as active_min by _time
| eval recommended=150, pct=round(100*active_min/recommended)
| sort - _time
description: Sums your weekly moderate-to-vigorous active minutes and compares them to the widely recommended 150-minute guideline.
value: Framing your week against the official activity guideline turns exercise into a simple pass/fail health target anyone can understand.
implementation: Ingest Fitbit or Apple active-minutes data; schedule weekly and alert when you fall short of the guideline.
visualization: Gauge or column chart of active minutes against the 150-minute line.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whether you got the amount of exercise health experts recommend each week.
